create_Net_model: create a Net model with configurable num_actions, input_channels, and optional LSTM for Atari RL
run_Net_forward: run the Net forward pass with state, reward, prev_action inputs to get policy logits and actions
create_model_factory: create an Atari RL model using create_model with flags for LSTM and device placement
test_Net_initial_state: test the Net initial_state method to get zero-initialized LSTM hidden and cell states
review_Net_resnet_architecture: review the Net class resnet-style convolutional blocks with skip connections for feature extraction
